theme-editor.start-view.it-uses-home-ass.text: It uses Home Assistant tags such as !secret.

theme-editor.start-view.its-file-holds-s.text: Its file holds several themes, and saving would rewrite all of them.

theme-editor.start-view.loading-presets.note: Screen-reader label of the spinner while the preset list loads. No dots.

theme-editor.start-view.loading-themes.note: Screen-reader label of the spinner while the theme list loads. No dots.

theme-editor.start-view.lowercase-letter.text: Lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores. Used as the file name.

theme-editor.start-view.n-saved-under-my.text: {n, plural, one {# preset is} other {# presets are}} saved under My presets, but a preset is not a theme yet. Choose New theme and pick it to make one.
theme-editor.start-view.n-saved-under-my.note: Empty-state help. {n} is the number of saved presets. My presets and New theme are a section name and a button label; match them.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

theme-editor.start-view.new-theme.note: Button and dialog title for making a new theme from the start view.

theme-editor.start-view.no-theme-called-.note: Empty search result. {query} is the text typed in the theme search box; do not translate it.

vars.query: The value that replaces query in the text.

theme-editor.start-view.pick-a-preset-to.text: Pick a preset to start from

theme-editor.start-view.presets-could-no.text: Presets could not load. Check your connection and try again. If it keeps failing, reload the page.

theme-editor.start-view.read-only.note: Badge on a theme card for a file that cannot be changed from here. Same English as the editor badge.

theme-editor.start-view.reading.note: Busy text while a chosen preset file is being read. Keep the three dots.

theme-editor.start-view.search-themes.note: Placeholder of the search box that filters the list of themes.

theme-editor.start-view.start-from.note: Label above the choices Blank, A preset and Installed theme in the new theme dialog.

theme-editor.start-view.the-file-could-n.text: The file could not be read as YAML.

theme-editor.start-view.the-file-is-a-li.text: The file is a link to somewhere else.

theme-editor.start-view.the-file-is-too-.text: The file is too large to edit here.

theme-editor.start-view.the-file-name-is.text: The file name is not a name this editor can write.

theme-editor.start-view.the-theme-name-d.text: The theme name does not match the file name.

theme-editor.start-view.themes.note: Main heading of the start view above the list of themes. Same English as the editor breadcrumb.

theme-editor.start-view.this-removes-con.text: This removes /config/{file} and the other {c, plural, one {# theme} other {# themes}} in that file. Screens that use it, such as wall tablets, switch to the default theme.
theme-editor.start-view.this-removes-con.note: Delete confirmation body when the file holds several themes. {file} is the file name, such as themes.yaml (path stays untranslated); {c} is the number of other themes in it.

vars.c: The count the text is about.
vars.file: The value that replaces file in the text.

theme-editor.start-view.this-removes-con.text: This removes /config/{file}. Screens that use it, such as wall tablets, switch to the default theme.
theme-editor.start-view.this-removes-con.note: Delete confirmation body in the start view when the file holds one theme. {file} is the file name; the path stays untranslated.

vars.file: The value that replaces file in the text.

theme-editor.start-view.try-again.note: Button that repeats a failed theme list load. Same English as the editor and preset dialog.

theme-editor.theme-editor.could-not-open.note: Error toast when opening a theme. {name} is the theme name; {reason} is a finished sentence saying why.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.
vars.reason: The value that replaces reason in the text.

theme-editor.theme-editor.deleted-name.note: Toast after a theme is deleted. {name} is the theme name.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

theme-editor.theme-editor.details.note: Heading of the section with the theme's name, file and other facts. Noun.

theme-editor.theme-editor.found-it-you-c.text: Found it. You can save themes now.

theme-editor.theme-editor.still-not-foun.text: Still not found. Restart Home Assistant if you have just added the lines.

theme-editor.theme-editor.the-check-fail.note: Error after the pre-save check. {reason} is a finished sentence saying why.

vars.reason: The value that replaces reason in the text.

theme-editor.theme-editor.the-editor-par.text: The editor parts of Magic Card could not be loaded. The editor ships with Magic Card as magic-card-theme-editor.js: update Magic Card to 2026.10.06 or newer if it keeps happening.

theme-editor.theme-editor.the-theme-edit.text: The theme editor could not load. Reload the page.

theme-editor.theme-editor.waiting-for-ho.text: Waiting for Home Assistant to connect...

theme-editor.tile.corner-radius-of-the-t.text: Corner radius of the tile icon.

theme-editor.tile.font-size-of-the-prima.text: Font size of the primary text.

theme-editor.tile.font-size-of-the-secon.text: Font size of the secondary text.

theme-editor.tile.font-weight-of-the-pri.text: Font weight of the primary text.

theme-editor.tile.font-weight-of-the-sec.text: Font weight of the secondary text.

theme-editor.tile.keeps-tiles-that-never.text: Keeps tiles that never wrap level with ones that do.

theme-editor.tile.letter-spacing-of-the-.text: Letter spacing of the primary text.
Letter spacing of the secondary text.

theme-editor.tile.line-height-of-the-pri.text: Line height of the primary text.

theme-editor.tile.line-height-of-the-sec.text: Line height of the secondary text.

theme-editor.tile.reserves-room-for-a-mi.text: Reserves room for a missing secondary line.

theme-editor.tile.vertical-gap-between-p.text: Vertical gap between primary and secondary text.

theme-editor.trial-bar.n-not-valid-left-.note: Note in the trial bar while trying a theme. {n} is the number of variables skipped because their values are invalid.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

theme-editor.trial-bar.trying-name.note: Trial bar title while a theme is applied to this tab only. {name} is the theme name.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

theme-editor.trial-bar.trying-name-on-th.text: Trying {name} on this tab ({mode, select, dark {dark} other {light}})
theme-editor.trial-bar.trying-name-on-th.note: Trial bar title. {name} is the theme name; {mode} is 'dark' or 'light'. 'This tab' means this browser tab.

vars.mode: The value that replaces mode in the text.
vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

theme-editor.trial.reverted-this-tab-sho.text: Reverted. This tab shows your own theme again.

theme-editor.trial.saved-this-tab-now-us.text: Saved. This tab now uses the saved theme file.

theme-editor.trial.trial-ended-because-t.text: Trial ended because the theme changed.

theme-editor.ultra-card.takes-priority-o.text: Takes priority over the card background.

theme-editor.util.a-and-b.note: Joins two items in a list. {a} and {b} are mode or panel names such as 'Light' and 'Dark'; do not add a comma.

vars.a: The value that replaces a in the text.
vars.b: The value that replaces b in the text.

theme-editor.util.a-theme-called-name-al.note: Validation error on the theme name field. {name} is the name the user typed.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

theme-editor.util.use-lowercase-letters-.text: Use lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores, starting with a letter or number (64 characters at most).
